findings.evidence: Five `show ... from` coercions in `exists_isAffineOpen_basicOpen_mem_of_isClosed`. None of them has a justifying comment.

findings.evidence: `have hUB : IsCompl (I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U) (I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ B) := by constructor ...` with a hand-written `simp only [Opens.coe_inf, Hom.coe_preimage, ...]` chain.
findings.fix: Factor it into a lemma, e.g. `isCompl_preimage_of_range_subset`. As an alternative, state it at the `Set` level and close it with `simp`/`grind` on `Set.disjoint_iff`/`Set.eq_univ_iff`.
findings.issue: The `hUB` proof (preimages of `U` and `{x}ᶜ` under `subschemeι` are complementary when `range = Uᶜ ∪ {x}`) is about 20 lines of `ext`/`simp only` set-chasing. It is inlined into a roughly 45-line proof, and it is a general fact about preimages of a covering pair along a map whose range lies in `Uᶜ ∪ {x}`.

summary: Several steps rely on undocumented definitional unfolding (`show ... from` between `Hom.preimage`/`Set` membership and `Γ`, plus a closing `rfl` across the free-sheaf/`Γ(X, U)` wrapper), and the `IsCompl` sub-proof is reusable reasoning inlined into a long proof.
